text:
maya: Quick flag — PR #2742 (schema migration) addressed review comments but needs one more approve + rebase before Friday deploy-freeze. Windows-e2e is stuck on `npm test` hang.
lee: Can someone rebase? I'm on infra rotation today. @jordan can you take it? Also can QA give a quick 👍 if no regressions?
jordan: I can rebase in ~15m, will push and trigger rebuild. Triggering rebuild when done: `ci-bot rebuild 2742`
ci-bot: Rebuild queued: PR 2742 — windows-e2e on node-5. Queue position: 2. ETA ~8m.
sam: If windows-e2e flakes, fallback plan is to land behind a feature flag and canary at 10% then widen. Prefer to avoid last-minute canary if we can get green before freeze.
lee: I can approve once green. @maya can you add a one-line changelog for release notes?
maya: Done, added changelog to the PR description and noted "no infra changes". @platform-team FYI. Jordan — holding for your push.
jordan: Pushed rebase and force-pushed branch -> `git push --force origin pr/2742`. Triggered CI.
ci-bot: CI status update: mac-matrix ✅, unit-tests ✅, windows-e2e running. Estimated remaining: ~6m.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Friday deploy-freeze starts 2024-03-01 00:00 UTC. Any merges after that will be deferred until the thaw.
jordan: All jobs green now. Requesting final +1 from @lee to merge.
lee: +1 from me. Wait ~30s to ensure no late flakes, then merge.
maya: :thumbsup: merging in 30s. Thanks for the quick turnaround, everyone.
